ideas: Filling labour shortages in ageing economies
Immigrants bring new skills and ideas
Integration and public services need proper planning

phrases.meaning: document allowing work in another country

model: I think countries should make immigration easier, although it needs to be managed carefully. First, many countries face a serious labour shortage. In Japan, for example, the population is shrinking, and many jobs in hospitals and factories are now done by foreign workers, including lots of Vietnamese people. Two of my former classmates were given work visas there, and they're helping to fill the gap in the care sector. Without them, many elderly people wouldn't be looked after properly. Another reason is that immigrants contribute to the economy in other ways. Skilled workers start businesses, pay taxes and bring a fresh perspective to companies. My team has an engineer from India, and some of our best ideas were suggested by him. While it's true that sudden increases in immigration can put pressure on public services, this can be solved with good planning and language classes that help people integrate into society. So overall, I believe easier immigration benefits everyone involved.
